books.section: The Rise of the Middle Class

stimulus.text: The image shows a Remington Standard typewriter of 1890: a heavy black machine with round keys arranged in rows, a roller at the top for holding paper, and a ruler marked with numbers across the middle. A small plate above the roller reads, in part, “Keep machine free from dust.”
stimulus.source_note: Remington Standard typewriter, 1890. Public domain image from Wikimedia Commons; viewed by the writer.

stem: The spread of machines like the one shown helped change the makeup of the office workforce because

options.text: typewriters eliminated the need for office workers entirely, so offices needed no workers at all
options.misconception: Typewriters created office jobs; they did not end them.

options.text: employers hired large numbers of women as typists and stenographers as typewriters and telephones multiplied
only men were permitted to operate typewriters in American offices
options.misconception: Women became the typical typists; the work was not restricted to men.

options.text: typewriters required every manager to write out all correspondence by hand
options.misconception: Typewriters replaced handwriting; they did not require more of it.

rationales.A: A machine that types letters needs someone to type. The workforce grew, it did not vanish.
rationales.B: Typing was new work that employers filled largely with women, who learned to type and took stenography jobs as the machines spread.
rationales.C: The new typing jobs went largely to women, not only to men.
rationales.D: The point of the machine was to replace handwriting with typed pages.
rationales.general:
Connect the machine to the workers it needed.
1. The image shows a machine for typing letters quickly.
2. Fast typing created new office jobs: typist and stenographer.
3. Background from the books: as typewriters and telephones multiplied, women entered office work in large numbers.
4. So the machine changed who worked in offices, not just how fast they worked.
Remember: a new tool changes a workforce when it creates jobs that new workers can fill.
